analytic_assessment.current_identifiability: For delivered split vectors y_s=g+f_common+f_s+n_s under fixed processing, all split differences cancel g and f_common. The transformation g->g+h, f_common->f_common-h leaves every y_s and difference unchanged. Thus the retained split contrasts alone do not bound common foreground contamination. This is conditional algebra, not a universal no-go theorem.

primary_source.identity: Marcori, Pitrou, Uzan and Pereira, arXiv:1805.12121v1, 30 May 2018; Phys. Rev. D 98, 023517; DOI 10.1103/PhysRevD.98.023517

result.finding: Equation 3.14 gives a two-geodesic flat-FLRW direction drift: transverse source-minus-observer velocity divided by distance, plus observer velocity drift. For the retained first-order dust history beta_s=(1+z)b and beta_o=b+ell, substitution gives the conditional candidate mu=P_n{c(z b−ell)/chi(z)+dot(beta_o)}. With ell=0, an exactly flat-FLRW geodesic observer has dot(beta_o)=−H_0 b, leaving P_n[c z/chi(z)−H_0]b. This can depend on depth. Under the paper’s pure-FLRW assumptions it is an E1 dipole, with no B1 curl at this order. The substitution does not qualify a Gaia or radio physical transfer.

assumptions_and_conventions: Signature(-,+,+,+), spatially flat ds^2=-c^2dt^2+a^2 dx^2. Physical tetrad velocities beta=v/c, e0=c^-1partial_t, ei=a^-1partial_i; a_o=1. Sourceward n; P_n=I-nn^T. Tangent coordinates are ICRS(mu_alpha*cos(delta),mu_delta), not d(alpha)/dt.

Reuse the finite post-decoupling compensated mode: beta_m(a)=b/a, beta_r(a)=-R b, R=3epsilon_m0/(4epsilon_r0); separately conserved positive dust and radiation, optional unperturbed Lambda. Set independent first-order density, metric, shear and lensing perturbations to zero. At every a, epsilon_m beta_m+(4/3)epsilon_r beta_r=a^-4[epsilon_m0-(4/3)epsilon_r0 R]b=0. Quadratic anisotropic stress is outside this approximation.

The physical candidate assumes a source centroid carried by the dust. beta_s=(1+zbar)b at the retarded emission event. Observer beta_o(t)=b/a(t)+ell(t); at t_o, dot(beta_o)=-H0 b+dot(ell). The derivative is in the normal tetrad and is not itself the matter four-acceleration. A nonrotating observer tetrad is chosen; arbitrary catalogue spin is a separate nuisance.

Source-observer proper-time ratio is already used once in the two-ray construction. dot(ell) is a free depth-independent angular acceleration coefficient; in exact FLRW the observer proper acceleration divided by c is dot(ell)+H0 ell. Real local metric/solar-system effects are not thereby modeled; their common dipole can be absorbed but remaining spatial/time terms are unknown.

The physical theorem is local at first order and at true background depths. The finite retained-row experiment fixes reported Quaia redshifts/directions. Photometric-redshift errors, catastrophe law, selection, source intrinsic motion and nonlinear physical remainder are not supplied by this plug-in design.

The quantitative velocity requirement is max(|b|/a_i,R|b|,|b+ell|)<<1, plus Doppler displacement small relative to the distance-redshift variation scale. It is a validity condition, not a prior. No finite remainder or nonzero interval of certified physical accuracy is established.

constructive_derivation.retarded_clock: To zeroth order dt_s/dt_o=a_s/a_o. Since dx_s/dt_s=c beta_s/a_s, its displacement per observer time is c beta_s/a_o. Likewise observer displacement is c beta_o/a_o. Differentiating the sourceward unit direction gives P_n c(beta_s-beta_o)/(a_o chi). First-order aberration adds P_n dot(beta_o). Source proper-time and cosmic-time differences are quadratic in velocities in this unperturbed metric. Adding a further1/(1+z) to the source term would double-count the clock conversion.
constructive_derivation.physical_response: mu_rad_per_time(n,zbar)=P_n{H0 k_b(zbar)b+H0 k_ell(zbar)ell+dot(ell)}+r_mu; I(z)=H0 chi(z)/c=integral_0^z du/E(u), k_b=z/I-1, k_ell=-1/I. The b column is a history response distinct from local observer velocity and the free common glide. r_mu is an unbounded physical/source/processing remainder here, never zero-filled for admission.
constructive_derivation.curl_and_acceleration: At each fixed true depth the displayed vector field is grad_S2[n dot constant], hence pure E1 and curl-free. The homogeneous dust is geodesic and spatially irrotational at this order. No omega/cosmic-curl or matter-four-acceleration response follows. A depth-dependent sample mask can mix fitted E/B coefficients; it does not alter the physical fixed-depth statement.
constructive_derivation.closed_background: Freeze the already evaluated synthetic background r=Omega_r=1/10000,Omega_m=1-r,Omega_Lambda=Omega_k=0,H0=70km/s/Mpc. E(z)=(1+z)^(3/2)*sqrt(1+r z). Put Q=sqrt((1+z)(1+r z)). Then I=2z/(1+z+Q), k_b=(z-1+Q)/2, k_ell=-(1+z+Q)/(2z). For stable evaluation use k_b=z/2*[1+(1+r+r z)/(Q+1)]. These are scalar closed forms; no quadrature or ODE is needed.
constructive_derivation.units: Let K_H=H0*(Julian_year_seconds)*(microarcseconds_per_radian), with1Julianyear=31557600s,1au=149597870700m,1pc=(648000/pi)au. For H0=70km/s/Mpc,K_H=14.76646685987891microas/yr. Define fit amplitudes a_b=K_H b and a_ell=K_H ell in microas/yr. Mean row is E_i[k_b a_b+k_ell a_ell+g], with g=dot(ell) converted to microas/yr, free and unconstrained. E_i rows are east_i^T,north_i^T. The scalar profiles are dimensionless.
constructive_derivation.null_limits: b=ell=dot(ell)=0 gives zero displayed PM. A source and observer sharing decaying dust do not generally give zero because they sample different emission times. With constant H, I=z and k_b=0 exactly. Near z=0, k_b=Eprime(0)z/2+O(z^2)=(3+r)z/4+O(z^2), while k_ell=-1/z-(3+r)/4+O(z). The local-velocity singularity requires z>0 and the finite-amplitude Doppler smallness condition. r->0 is the EdS scalar-control limit, not an admissible nonzero compensated-radiation history at r=0.

identification_lemmas.three_depth_theorem: For0<z1<z2<z3 and strictly concave positive I on[z1,z3], the3x3 profile matrix with rows[k_b(zj),k_ell(zj),1] is nonsingular. Multiply rowj byI_j, then add column3 to column1: the resulting rows are[zj,-1,I_j], with determinant equal to det(rows[1,zj,I_j]). Therefore det(profile)=det([1,z,I])/product(I_j). Strict concavity makes the latter negative for ordered depths, hence nonzero. Iprime=1/E and Isecond=-Eprime/E^2<0 when Eprime>0. Thus history, local velocity and common glide are distinguishable in the ideal angular/depth design. Cartesian three-component separation additionally requires sufficient angular support. The actual retained sample and added nuisance span must be tested numerically; this is not an empirical rank claim.
identification_lemmas.frame_quotient_theorem: For fixed retained rows/design/weights, let L be any linear contrast with L U=0. If the catalogue differs from ideal tangent PM by U c(y) for any possibly data-dependent coefficient vector, then L[y+U c(y)]=Ly pointwise. In particular if U includes global B1 and common E1, any additive global spin and common glide vanish. Spin coefficients may have been estimated using other sources; that does not change the result. For an operator T=I+B A,LB=0 implies L T=L for everyA. Full-sky E/B orthogonality is unnecessary. This does not cover source-dependent or time-dependent calibration outsidecol(U), changes of selected rows/weights, finite coordinate rotations without consistent basis transport, or a general NNR operator.
identification_lemmas.gaia_consequence: Gaia AppendixE qualifies the pure global rotation correction component. The proposed U includes all three binwise B1 triplets, hence global B1, and a common E1 triplet; it removes that component and the free observer glide under the fixed-design model. This narrows the previous undifferentiated frame/glide blocker. It does not establish source selection, residual spatial covariance or full detector calibration.
identification_lemmas.radio_countercondition: For radio sourcei with session slope functional ell_i and session spin c(t), correction to its fitted slope can be B_i ell_i[c(t)]. Different source epochs/weights and the five underlying solutions need not share ell_i[c(t)]. Thus even instantaneous rotational corrections can become source-dependent final PM corrections. A single common B1 quotient cannot be assumed to annihilate these. The actual radio NNR/time-series transfer remains HOLD; radio is excluded from the proposed new Gaia-only fit.
identification_lemmas.old_contrasts_relation: The six R23-Q low-minus-high and middle-minus-high E1 contrasts already remove a truly common E1 amplitude. The continuously varying profiles k_b,k_ell are not generally in the18 piecewise-constant E1/B1 span. Substituting bin-centre or unweighted bin-average kernels into old coefficients would not be the new retained-row estimator. Its exact weighted response requires new cross-moments.

working_covariance.status: a and b are frozen deterministic working choices obtained from released error scales, not published estimates of a physical variance decomposition. The total shape and shared components are explicit assumptions. The fitted sigma makes published errors relative covariance weights for this experiment, not validated total physical error bars.
working_covariance.calibration_accounting: The common a^2 budget is reallocated from the diagonal s_i^2, so diag[diag(s_i^2-a^2)+a^2 11^T]=s_i^2. Do not add a second linewidth, TFR calibration, adjustment-relation uncertainty, or catalogue RMS term. Appendix C already propagates such measured/fitted uncertainty into the reported modulus errors. The actual cross-row calibration covariance is still unknown.
working_covariance.group_pv_accounting: There is exactly one added group-level residual term b^2 GG^T. It is an authored aggregate model for unresolved group/PV-related distance residual dependence. It is not a source-qualified peculiar-velocity covariance or an estimate of velocity dispersion. Source no-double-counting of every physical PV contribution cannot be established from these inputs; retain that physical qualification as HOLD. Do not add another PV draw or covariance on top.
working_covariance.positive_definiteness: s_i^2-a^2 >=0.75*s_i^2>0, so V is strictly positive definite for every group partition. Full274 V is the sole covariance passed to the density and fitted estimator.
working_covariance.low_redshift: Vcmb ranges317..10459 km/s. Log(Vcmb) is only a positive observed covariate in this model. No expansion in v_pec/Vcmb or conversion from Vcmb to a true distance is used, including for PGC9031 at317 km/s.
working_covariance.sensitivity: Do not report a physical bounded covariance/selection sensitivity envelope. No source-qualified bounds were acquired. The exact unrestricted common-zero-point invariance is a mathematical property of this one declared model, not a calibrated physical sensitivity range.

estimation.normalized_factor: F_M(y|beta,sigma)=N_274(y;X beta,sigma^2 V). log F=-0.5[n log(2*pi)+n log(sigma^2)+logdet V+RSS(beta)/sigma^2]. Use Cholesky solves, never an explicit inverse.
estimation.GLS: beta_hat=(X^T V^-1 X)^-1 X^T V^-1 y. n=274, p=rank(X)=7, nu=267. RSS=(y-X beta_hat)^T V^-1(y-X beta_hat). s_hat^2=RSS/nu for intervals; sigma_ML^2=RSS/n for maximum likelihood. Report both with their meanings.
estimation.interval: A=(X^T V^-1 X)^-1. Delta_hat=0.1*beta_hat[width]. SE(Delta_hat)=0.1*sqrt(s_hat^2*A_width,width). The95% interval is Delta_hat +/- t_(267,0.975)*SE. Under the declared Gaussian conditional law the pivot is exactly t_267; this covers the conditional coefficient, not physical distances or survey selection.
estimation.derivation: Whiten by L^-1, V=LL^T. Ordinary least squares in whitened space gives independent Gaussian coefficient error and RSS/sigma^2~chi_square(n-p). The t pivot follows. root=Path.cwd()
p=root/'docs/research_program/observational_publication_20261015/CONTINUOUS_RESEARCH_20261023/execution/R23-DISTANCE'
d=p/'conditional_fit'

expected='dddb9635d8d761aa0ac194f93546f86da61f03a5ac6598f1e9df71843bd8c0ff'

assert len(set(groups.values()))==622 and len(gc)==269
assert Counter(gc.values())=={1:264,2:5}
outcomes=['accepted','other_quality','confused','nondetection']

z=np.column_stack([np.log10(arr('vcmb_km_s')),arr('logWmxi'),arr('e_logWmxi')])

a=s.min()/2; b=np.median(s)

flagged=[raw[i]['pgc'] for i in np.flatnonzero(~mask)]

assumptions_and_conventions: Signature(-,+,+,+), spatially flat ds^2=-c^2dt^2+a^2 dx^2. Physical tetrad velocities beta=v/c, e0=c^-1partial_t, ei=a^-1partial_i; a_o=1. Sourceward n; P_n=I-nn^T. Tangent coordinates are ICRS(mu_alpha*cos(delta),mu_delta), not d(alpha)/dt.

Reuse the finite post-decoupling compensated mode: beta_m(a)=b/a, beta_r(a)=-R b, R=3epsilon_m0/(4epsilon_r0); separately conserved positive dust and radiation, optional unperturbed Lambda. Set independent first-order density, metric, shear and lensing perturbations to zero. At every a, epsilon_m beta_m+(4/3)epsilon_r beta_r=a^-4[epsilon_m0-(4/3)epsilon_r0 R]b=0. Quadratic anisotropic stress is outside this approximation.

The physical candidate assumes a source centroid carried by the dust. beta_s=(1+zbar)b at the retarded emission event. Observer beta_o(t)=b/a(t)+ell(t); at t_o, dot(beta_o)=-H0 b+dot(ell). The derivative is in the normal tetrad and is not itself the matter four-acceleration. A nonrotating observer tetrad is chosen; arbitrary catalogue spin is a separate nuisance.

Source-observer proper-time ratio is already used once in the two-ray construction. dot(ell) is a free depth-independent angular acceleration coefficient; in exact FLRW the observer proper acceleration divided by c is dot(ell)+H0 ell. Real local metric/solar-system effects are not thereby modeled; their common dipole can be absorbed but remaining spatial/time terms are unknown.

The physical theorem is local at first order and at true background depths. The finite retained-row experiment fixes reported Quaia redshifts/directions. Photometric-redshift errors, catastrophe law, selection, source intrinsic motion and nonlinear physical remainder are not supplied by this plug-in design.

The quantitative velocity requirement is max(|b|/a_i,R|b|,|b+ell|)<<1, plus Doppler displacement small relative to the distance-redshift variation scale. It is a validity condition, not a prior. No finite remainder or nonzero interval of certified physical accuracy is established.

constructive_derivation.retarded_clock: To zeroth order dt_s/dt_o=a_s/a_o. Since dx_s/dt_s=c beta_s/a_s, its displacement per observer time is c beta_s/a_o. Likewise observer displacement is c beta_o/a_o. Differentiating the sourceward unit direction gives P_n c(beta_s-beta_o)/(a_o chi). First-order aberration adds P_n dot(beta_o). Source proper-time and cosmic-time differences are quadratic in velocities in this unperturbed metric. Adding a further1/(1+z) to the source term would double-count the clock conversion.
constructive_derivation.physical_response: mu_rad_per_time(n,zbar)=P_n{H0 k_b(zbar)b+H0 k_ell(zbar)ell+dot(ell)}+r_mu; I(z)=H0 chi(z)/c=integral_0^z du/E(u), k_b=z/I-1, k_ell=-1/I. The b column is a history response distinct from local observer velocity and the free common glide. r_mu is an unbounded physical/source/processing remainder here, never zero-filled for admission.
constructive_derivation.curl_and_acceleration: At each fixed true depth the displayed vector field is grad_S2[n dot constant], hence pure E1 and curl-free. The homogeneous dust is geodesic and spatially irrotational at this order. No omega/cosmic-curl or matter-four-acceleration response follows. A depth-dependent sample mask can mix fitted E/B coefficients; it does not alter the physical fixed-depth statement.
constructive_derivation.closed_background: Freeze the already evaluated synthetic background r=Omega_r=1/10000,Omega_m=1-r,Omega_Lambda=Omega_k=0,H0=70km/s/Mpc. E(z)=(1+z)^(3/2)*sqrt(1+r z). Put Q=sqrt((1+z)(1+r z)). Then I=2z/(1+z+Q), k_b=(z-1+Q)/2, k_ell=-(1+z+Q)/(2z). For stable evaluation use k_b=z/2*[1+(1+r+r z)/(Q+1)]. These are scalar closed forms; no quadrature or ODE is needed.
constructive_derivation.units: Let K_H=H0*(Julian_year_seconds)*(microarcseconds_per_radian), with1Julianyear=31557600s,1au=149597870700m,1pc=(648000/pi)au. For H0=70km/s/Mpc,K_H=14.76646685987891microas/yr. Define fit amplitudes a_b=K_H b and a_ell=K_H ell in microas/yr. Mean row is E_i[k_b a_b+k_ell a_ell+g], with g=dot(ell) converted to microas/yr, free and unconstrained. E_i rows are east_i^T,north_i^T. The scalar profiles are dimensionless.
constructive_derivation.null_limits: b=ell=dot(ell)=0 gives zero displayed PM. A source and observer sharing decaying dust do not generally give zero because they sample different emission times. With constant H, I=z and k_b=0 exactly. Near z=0, k_b=Eprime(0)z/2+O(z^2)=(3+r)z/4+O(z^2), while k_ell=-1/z-(3+r)/4+O(z). The local-velocity singularity requires z>0 and the finite-amplitude Doppler smallness condition. r->0 is the EdS scalar-control limit, not an admissible nonzero compensated-radiation history at r=0.

identification_lemmas.three_depth_theorem: For0<z1<z2<z3 and strictly concave positive I on[z1,z3], the3x3 profile matrix with rows[k_b(zj),k_ell(zj),1] is nonsingular. Multiply rowj byI_j, then add column3 to column1: the resulting rows are[zj,-1,I_j], with determinant equal to det(rows[1,zj,I_j]). Therefore det(profile)=det([1,z,I])/product(I_j). Strict concavity makes the latter negative for ordered depths, hence nonzero. Iprime=1/E and Isecond=-Eprime/E^2<0 when Eprime>0. Thus history, local velocity and common glide are distinguishable in the ideal angular/depth design. Cartesian three-component separation additionally requires sufficient angular support. The actual retained sample and added nuisance span must be tested numerically; this is not an empirical rank claim.
identification_lemmas.frame_quotient_theorem: For fixed retained rows/design/weights, let L be any linear contrast with L U=0. If the catalogue differs from ideal tangent PM by U c(y) for any possibly data-dependent coefficient vector, then L[y+U c(y)]=Ly pointwise. In particular if U includes global B1 and common E1, any additive global spin and common glide vanish. Spin coefficients may have been estimated using other sources; that does not change the result. For an operator T=I+B A,LB=0 implies L T=L for everyA. Full-sky E/B orthogonality is unnecessary. This does not cover source-dependent or time-dependent calibration outsidecol(U), changes of selected rows/weights, finite coordinate rotations without consistent basis transport, or a general NNR operator.
identification_lemmas.gaia_consequence: Gaia AppendixE qualifies the pure global rotation correction component. The proposed U includes all three binwise B1 triplets, hence global B1, and a common E1 triplet; it removes that component and the free observer glide under the fixed-design model. This narrows the previous undifferentiated frame/glide blocker. It does not establish source selection, residual spatial covariance or full detector calibration.
identification_lemmas.radio_countercondition: For radio sourcei with session slope functional ell_i and session spin c(t), correction to its fitted slope can be B_i ell_i[c(t)]. Different source epochs/weights and the five underlying solutions need not share ell_i[c(t)]. Thus even instantaneous rotational corrections can become source-dependent final PM corrections. A single common B1 quotient cannot be assumed to annihilate these. The actual radio NNR/time-series transfer remains HOLD; radio is excluded from the proposed new Gaia-only fit.
identification_lemmas.old_contrasts_relation: The six R23-Q low-minus-high and middle-minus-high E1 contrasts already remove a truly common E1 amplitude. The continuously varying profiles k_b,k_ell are not generally in the18 piecewise-constant E1/B1 span. Substituting bin-centre or unweighted bin-average kernels into old coefficients would not be the new retained-row estimator. Its exact weighted response requires new cross-moments.

import csv,json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np
import scipy
from scipy import stats
from scipy.linalg import cholesky
root=Path.cwd()
p=root/'docs/research_program/observational_publication_20261015/CONTINUOUS_RESEARCH_20261023/execution/R23-DISTANCE'
d=p/'conditional_fit'
sha=lambda q:hashlib.sha256(q.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
expected='dddb9635d8d761aa0ac194f93546f86da61f03a5ac6598f1e9df71843bd8c0ff'
assert sha(d/'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json')==expected
for base in [p,d]:
    manifest=json.loads((base/'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json').read_text())
    for name,rec in manifest['files'].items():
        q=base/name
        assert sha(q)==rec['sha256'],str(q)
        assert q.stat().st_size==rec['bytes'],str(q)
assert sha(d/'CONTRACT.json')==sha(root/'.agent-harness/runtime/r23-continuous/DISTANCE_RESEARCH_RAW.json')
old=json.loads((d/'PRE_RECEIPT_RESEAL_MANIFEST.json').read_text())
new=json.loads((d/'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json').read_text())
changed=[k for k in new['files'] if new['files'][k]!=old['files'][k]]
assert changed==['FIRST_FAILURE.txt']
history=json.loads((d/'PACKAGING_HISTORY.json').read_text())
assert sha(d/history['initial_manifest'])==history['initial_manifest_sha256']
assert sha(d/history['initial_failure_summary'])==history['initial_failure_summary_sha256']
assert sha(d/history['expanded_full_failure'])==history['expanded_full_failure_sha256']
up=Path('/mnt/extdrive/workdir/htt_open_data/cf4/upstream_20261018')
source_refs=json.loads((p/'EXTRACTION.json').read_text())['source_sha256']
for fn,h in source_refs.items(): assert sha(Path(fn))==h,fn
ledger=list(csv.DictReader(Path('/mnt/extdrive/workdir/htt_open_data/cf4/D02_HI_CF4_20261018/TARGET_JOIN_AND_OOF.csv').open()))
raw=list(csv.DictReader((p/'RELEASED_ROWS.csv').open()))
out=list(csv.DictReader((d/'ROWS.csv').open()))
assert len(ledger)==628 and len(raw)==len(out)==274
assert [x['pgc'] for x in raw]==[x['pgc'] for x in out]
ids={x['pgc'] for x in raw}
assert len(ids)==274 and len({x['pgc'] for x in ledger}-ids)==354
# Independently parse source fixed-width coordinates from the read release schema.
width_lines={int(x[:7]):x for x in (up/'table1.dat').read_text().splitlines()}
dm_lines={int(x[:7]):x for x in (up/'table4.dat').read_text().splitlines()}
for x in raw:
    z=dm_lines[int(x['pgc'])]; w=width_lines[int(x['pgc'])]
    assert float(x['DMbest_mag'])==float(z[26:31])
    assert float(x['e_DMbest_mag'])==float(z[32:36])
    assert float(x['vcmb_km_s'])==float(z[14:19])
    assert float(x['logWmxi'])==float(w[54:59])
    assert float(x['e_logWmxi'])==float(w[60:65])
groups={x['pgc']:('CF4:'+x['CF4_group'] if x['CF4_group'] else 'UNASSIGNED_PGC:'+x['pgc']) for x in ledger}
labels=[groups[x['pgc']] for x in raw]
gc=Counter(labels)
assert len(set(groups.values()))==622 and len(gc)==269
assert Counter(gc.values())=={1:264,2:5}
outcomes=['accepted','other_quality','confused','nondetection']
marks=[[sum(x['outcome']==o and x['pgc'] not in ids for x in ledger),sum(x['outcome']==o and x['pgc'] in ids for x in ledger)] for o in outcomes]
assert marks==[[116,269],[21,1],[26,3],[191,1]]
arr=lambda f:np.array([float(x[f]) for x in raw])
y=arr('DMbest_mag'); s=arr('e_DMbest_mag')
z=np.column_stack([np.log10(arr('vcmb_km_s')),arr('logWmxi'),arr('e_logWmxi')])
X=np.column_stack([np.ones(274),z-z.mean(0),*[np.array([x['outcome']==o for x in raw],float) for o in outcomes[1:]]])
a=s.min()/2; b=np.median(s)
same_group=np.equal.outer(labels,labels).astype(float)
V=np.diag(s*s-a*a)+a*a+b*b*same_group
np.testing.assert_allclose(np.diag(V)-b*b,s*s,rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-14)
ev,U=np.linalg.eigh(V)
assert min(ev)>0
# Symmetric-eigen whitening and SVD least squares are independent of candidate QR/triangular fit.
W=(U/np.sqrt(ev))@U.T
Z=W@X; wy=W@y
beta,_,rank,_=np.linalg.lstsq(Z,wy,rcond=None)
assert rank==7
res=y-X@beta
rss=float(np.sum((W@res)**2)); sigma2=rss/274; s2=rss/267
P=np.linalg.pinv(Z)
se=float(.1*np.sqrt(s2*np.sum(P[2]**2)))
delta=float(.1*beta[2])
ci=delta+np.array([-1,1])*stats.t.ppf(.975,267)*se
r=json.loads((d/'RESULT.json').read_text())
np.testing.assert_allclose(beta,r['fit']['coefficients'],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
np.testing.assert_allclose(ci,r['fit']['delta_t95_interval_mag'],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
np.testing.assert_allclose(rss,r['fit']['rss_whitened'],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
loglike=float(stats.multivariate_normal.logpdf(y,mean=X@beta,cov=sigma2*V))
np.testing.assert_allclose(loglike,r['conditional_distance_log_likelihood_at_ml'],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
shift=137.125
beta_shift=np.linalg.lstsq(Z,W@(y+shift),rcond=None)[0]
np.testing.assert_allclose(beta_shift-beta,np.array([shift,0,0,0,0,0,0]),rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
np.testing.assert_allclose(y+shift-X@beta_shift,res,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
L=cholesky(V,lower=True)
CX=np.linalg.solve(L,X); cr=np.linalg.solve(L,res)
Hdiag=np.sum(CX*np.linalg.pinv(CX).T,axis=1)
mask=1-Hdiag>1e-12
T=float(np.max(abs(cr[mask])/np.sqrt(s2*(1-Hdiag[mask]))))
np.testing.assert_allclose(T,r['diagnostic']['T_actual'],rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
flagged=[raw[i]['pgc'] for i in np.flatnonzero(~mask)]
assert flagged==r['diagnostic']['zero_residual_leverage_PGCs']==['53938']
for i,row in enumerate(out):
    for f,v in [('fitted_mean_mag',(X@beta)[i]),('residual_mag',res[i]),('whitened_residual',cr[i])]:
        np.testing.assert_allclose(float(row[f]),v,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-10)
    assert row['group_id']==groups[row['pgc']]
low=int(stats.binom.ppf(.005,4096,.95)); high=int(stats.binom.ppf(.995,4096,.95))
assert [low,high]==r['mock']['acceptance_count_range']
assert low<=r['mock']['covered']<=high
binci=list(stats.binomtest(3890,4096).proportion_ci(.95,method='exact'))
np.testing.assert_allclose(binci,r['mock']['binomial_exact_95_interval'],rtol=1e-12,atol=1e-12)
assert r['diagnostic']['p_plus_one']==(1+3)/(1+4096)
assert r['diagnostic']['conditional_law_criticized'] is True
assert r['H02_S02']=='HOLD' and r['physical_admission']=='HOLD'
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','candidate_sha256':sha(d/'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json'),'sealed_files_verified':11,
'initial_manifest_files_verified':len(json.loads((p/'ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json').read_text())['files']),
'four_source_identities_and_all_released_source_fields':'PASS','protected_initial_receipt_sha256':sha(p/'RAW_RECEIPT.json'),
'contract_matches_research_raw':True,'packaging_changed_entries':changed,'cohort_counts':[628,274,354],
'group_counts':[622,269,264,5],'mark_counts':marks,'rank':int(rank),'nu':267,
'minimum_V_eigenvalue':float(min(ev)),'beta':beta.tolist(),
'max_beta_difference':float(max(abs(beta-np.array(r['fit']['coefficients'])))),
'rss':rss,'sigma2_ml':sigma2,'s2_interval':s2,'loglike':loglike,'delta':delta,'delta_se':se,'ci95':ci.tolist(),
'zero_point_shift_test_mag':shift,'actual_T':T,'zero_residual_leverage_PGCs':flagged,
'binomial_count_range':[low,high],'binomial_exact95':binci,'diagnostic_p':r['diagnostic']['p_plus_one'],
'mocks_reexecuted':False,'all_274_saved_row_fits_reconciled':True,'python':sys.version,'numpy':np.__version__,'scipy':scipy.__version__},indent=2))
